purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer configuration, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: ATR/BPN BHUMI is an official public national land-map service relevant to Gresik. Its current JavaScript/configuration was inspected: the map route uses a same-origin /api/proksi relay and has a Geoserver parcel path (/expapi/getPersil) that is session/token-backed. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was used. The official Gresik Regency GIS portal returned an authentication page. No parcel geometry or native parcel identity was retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound remains null: the national public viewer establishes a relevant official service, while the Gresik-specific portal is login-gated and no Gresik parcel response was verified. The 2016 Gresik one-map legal abstract is administrative context only.
